description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Under section 2 of the Revenue Protection Act No. 19 of 1962. Revenue Protection order No 04/2025
categorisation: The gazette content is a "CUSTOMS NOTIFICATION" issued under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962. Its primary purpose is to announce a new regulatory order (Revenue Protection Order No. 04/2025) that sets or modifies import duty rates for specific goods. This falls squarely under the definition of **Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5)**, which includes "New laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations," "Statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation," and "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." Although it is issued by a named Minister, the core content is the regulatory change itself, not a government personnel or structural change. Therefore, the specialized legal/regulatory classification takes precedence over a government personnel classification.
